S1:12.text: And God ſaid This is the ſigne of the couenant which. I geue between me and you, and between euerie liuing ſoule, that is with you, for perpetual generations: ::

S1:13.text: †my bowe 13; wil I ſet in the clouds, and it ſhal be the ſigne of a couenant betwen me and betwen the earth.

S1:14.text: And when I ſhal cower the element with cloudes, my bowe ſhal appeare in the cloudes:

S1:15.text: and I ſhal remember my couenant with you, and with euerie liuing ſoule that beareth flesh: and there ſhal no more be waters of a floud, to diſtroy al flesh.

S1:3.text: And"al that moueth, and liueth ſhal be yours for ; meat cuen as the grene herbes haue I deliuered al to you.

S1:4.text: Sawing that flesh with bloud you ſhal not eate.

S1:5.text: For I wil require the bloud of your ſoules at the hands of al beaſts: and at the hand of man, at the hand of eech man, and of his brother, wil I require the ſoule of man.

S3:2.text: And your terror and dread be it vpon al the beaſts of the earth, and vpon al the foules of the ayre, with al that moue vpon the earth al the fishes of the ſea are deliuered to your hand.

S6:1.text: ND God bleſſed Noe and his ſonnes. And he ſaid to them: Increaſe & multiplie, and repleniſh the earth.

S6:19.text: Theſe three are the ſonnes of Noe: and of theſe was al mankind ſpred ouer the whole earth.

S6:2.text: And your terrour and dread be it vpon al the beaſts of the earth, and vpon al the foules of the ayre, with al that moue vpon the earth: al the fiſhes of the ſea are deliuered to your hand.

S6:3.text: And "al that moueth and liueth ſhal be yours for meat euen as the green hearbs haue I deliuered al to you.

S6:8.text: Thus alſo ſaid God to Noe, and to his ſonnes with him:

S9:10.text: and with euerie liuing ſoule, that is with you, as wel in al foules as in cattle & beaſts of the earth that are come forth out of the arke, and in al beaſts of the earth.

S9:13.text: my bowe I wil I ſet in the clouds, and it ſhal be the ſigne of a couenant betwen me and between the earth.

S9:14.text: And when I ſhal couer the element with cloudes, my bowe ſhal appeare in the cloudes:

S9:16.text: And my bowe ſhal be in the cloudes, and I ſhal ſee it, and I ſhal remember the euerlaſting couenant, that was made betwen God and euerie liuing ſoule of al flesh which is vpon the earth.

S9:20.text: And Noe a huſbandman began to til the grounde, and planted a vineyard.

S9:4.text: Sauing that flesh with bloud you ſhal not eate.

S9:5.text: †For I wil require the bloud of your ſoules at the hands of al beaſts: and at the hand of man, at the hand of eech man, and of his brother, wil I require the ſoule of man.

S9:6.text: ſoeuer ſhal ſheed mans bloud, his bloud that be ſhed for to the image of God man was made.
